findings.title: Unsubscribe crashes when no TopicUser row exists
findings.body: In app/controllers/topics_controller.rb the unsubscribe action does tu = TopicUser.find_by(...) then immediately reads tu.notification_level. A user who was never tracked in the topic (e.g. mentioned by email, first visit via email link) has no row, so find_by returns nil and the request raises NoMethodError on nil, returning 500 instead of unsubscribing.

findings.title: State-changing unsubscribe exposed as GET
findings.body: In config/routes.rb the new endpoints get t/:slug/:topic_id/unsubscribe and get t/:topic_id/unsubscribe map to TopicsController#unsubscribe which mutates TopicUser.notification_level and saves. GETs are not CSRF-protected, are prefetched by email clients/crawlers, and are retried on refresh, so an attacker can force a victim's browser to load an image/URL to silently downgrade their subscription, and a refresh double-applies the downgrade.

findings.title: Direct save bypasses notification-level side effects
findings.body: In app/controllers/topics_controller.rb unsubscribe mutates tu.notification_level and calls tu.save! directly instead of TopicUser.change. That skips updating notifications_changed_at, notifications_reason_id, MessageBus notification_level_change publish and tracking-state handling done by the canonical path, leaving clients/stale caches out of sync.

findings.title: Watching users need two visits to actually mute
findings.body: In app/controllers/topics_controller.rb unsubscribe only steps down one level per hit: if level > regular it sets regular, else muted. A watching/tracking user clicking the email link advertised as stop receiving notifications ends up still on regular and still receives notifications, requiring a second visit to reach muted.

findings.title: New unsubscribe_link interpolation breaks emails without unsubscribe_url
findings.body: In config/locales/server.en.yml unsubscribe_link now requires both %{user_preferences_url} and %{unsubscribe_url}. In lib/email/message_builder.rb body and html_part unconditionally interpolate that key whenever add_unsubscribe_link is true. Any existing caller that sets add_unsubscribe_link without passing unsubscribe_url now raises I18n::MissingInterpolationArgument and fails to send the email.

findings.title: Client-side navigation never triggers server unsubscribe
findings.body: In app/assets/javascripts/discourse/routes/topic-unsubscribe.js.es6 model() only calls PostStream.loadTopicView (TopicsController#show JSON), never the new TopicsController#unsubscribe endpoint. The server downgrade only runs on full-page HTML load, so navigating to /t/slug/id/unsubscribe inside the Ember app shows the page without actually changing the notification level.
